name: Verify email address
description: Confirms an address with a single click and no code, for flows where verification always completes on the device that opened the email.

origin.note: Design: single action — one button, nothing competing with it, raw URL underneath because a stripped button leaves nothing else.

subject: Confirm your email address
preheader: One click and you're done. The link is good for {{ expires_in }}.

user.first_name.description: Recipient's first name. Falls back to a generic greeting when absent.

body.description: Opening paragraph. With no code to fall back on, say plainly what the button does.
body.default: Click the button below and your address is confirmed. Nothing else to enter.

action_url.description: The verification link. Required here — this variant has no code, so there is no second path.

expires_in.description: How long the link stays valid.

fallback_note.description: Line above the raw URL. Not optional in a link-only flow: a stripped or rewritten button leaves the recipient with nothing.
fallback_note.default: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

security_note.default: If you didn't create an account, ignore this email and nothing will happen.
